updateInfo.title: What's New
updateInfo.feature1: 3D terrain view is now available on mobile, showing your layer data, PMTiles, GPS location and the track being recorded
updateInfo.feature2: Added "View from here": see the 3D view from a point chosen in the long-press menu or from your current location, with peak names, telephoto/wide angle and following the direction your device faces
updateInfo.feature3: Peak names can now be shown on the 2D and 3D maps, and the GEBCO bathymetry map can be shown in 3D
updateInfo.feature4: The 2D map can now be rotated with two fingers. While rotated, the compass points to the map's north; tap it to return to north up
updateInfo.feature5: External GNSS receivers (USB or Bluetooth LE) can now be used for RTK positioning with NTRIP corrections (Android), with position averaging and recording of the fix type and ellipsoidal height
updateInfo.feature6: Many other improvements and bug fixes

GpsSettings.note: Changes take effect immediately, including while GPS or track recording is on.

high.title: High accuracy
high.description: Uses the most accurate location. Consumes more battery.

medium.title: Balanced
medium.description: Balances location accuracy and battery consumption.

low.title: Battery saver
low.description: Reduces battery consumption. Location accuracy is lower.

externalGnss.description: Uses the position from a receiver connected via USB or Bluetooth (BLE) for the current location, tracks and points. Falls back to the built-in GPS if positions stop for 5 seconds.
externalGnss.descriptionBleOnly: Uses the position from a receiver connected via Bluetooth (BLE) for the current location, tracks and points. Falls back to the built-in GPS if positions stop for 5 seconds.
externalGnss.noDevices: No USB devices found. Connect the receiver and tap Refresh.
externalGnss.noBleDevices: Turn on the receiver and tap Scan.
externalGnss.autoConnectNote: Connects automatically to {{name}} from now on
externalGnss.antennaHeightNote: Height from the ground to the antenna. Subtracted from the recorded elevation.
externalGnss.baudRateNote: Only for receivers that use a USB-serial converter (FTDI, CP210x, CH340, etc.); match the receiver's output speed. Not used for receivers connected directly over USB (such as the ZED-F9P) or over Bluetooth.

track.title: Track recording
track.adaptiveNote: Records after moving about twice the accuracy (about 10 cm with FIX, 1 m with FLOAT). Keeps one point every 30 s while stopped.
track.distanceNote: Records after moving the selected distance. Fewer points, suited to route logging. Keeps one point every 30 s while stopped.
track.allNote: Records every fix each second. Keeps the time while stopped but produces many points.
